audit_name: NAGARSETU Phase 4 Drainage Dataset Quality & Expansion Audit

normal_concrete_gutters.description: Functional concrete gutters with clear water flow, dry surfaces, no standing sludge, unbroken grates.

clean_dry_culverts.description: Natural and concrete culverts during dry season, showing light sand/silt without structural wall collapse.

blocked_drains_with_silt.description: Drains clogged by solid silt, construction debris, or municipal garbage causing flow stagnation.

damaged_drains_slab_collapse.description: Cracked concrete slabs, missing cast iron covers, washed-out side walls.

drain_overflow_monsoon.description: Stormwater overtopping curbs into pedestrian or vehicular pathways.

split_proposal.isolation_protocol: Group-based sequence hashing to prevent multi-angle camera burst leakage across splits.
split_proposal.negative_class_target_ratio: 35% of total dataset dedicated to normal/clean drains to eliminate false positive alarms.
